title: FTSE Russell — preliminary December 2026 additions/deletions published, the first December preliminary list in the family's history
source: EST: owner-published date, stated twice and verbatim on FTSE Russell's own reconstitution page, lseg.com/en/ftse-russell/russell-reconstitution, fetched direct 2026-09-06 (HTTP 200, 228,333 bytes, 13,561 characters of text extracted in-session): "Beginning on November 13, the preliminary lists are communicated to the marketplace", and in the FAQ "Preliminary lists for the upcoming December 2026 Reconstitution will be communicated beginning November 13, with updates on November 20, November 27, December 4, and December 11." INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCED FROM THE RULE: FTSE Russell, "Russell US Equity Indexes" construction and methodology, v7.2, August 2026 (lseg.com dam PDF, HTTP 200, 746,491 bytes, text-extracted in-session the same day), Appendix F's December column gives Preliminary Information Released = "Four weeks prior to implementation" and section 4.3.1 repeats it -- changes are announced "four weeks prior to the December review". The December 2026 implementation is 2026-12-11 (see the sibling proposal russell-reconstitution-2026-12-11.from-russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25.json), and 2026-11-13 to 2026-12-11 is exactly 28 days, matching the four-week rule to the day. Filed estimate because a proposal is always estimate by contract and this calendar's confirmed-tier prefixes have no member for an index owner's own published schedule. Discovered during the russell-recon-preliminary-2027-05-21 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-recon-preliminary-2027-05-21 initial research (2026-09-06). WHY IT IS WORTH A SEPARATE ENTRY: it is the first Russell preliminary-list publication that has ever happened in December, and it is 68 days out where the June 2027 instance this proposer owns is 257. The proposer measured the June announcement mechanic across the eight years whose announcement date is sourced from the owner's own schedule press releases (2019-2026) and found the announcement-to-implementation window a null (IWM-vs-SPY mean -0.01%, bootstrap p=42%) and the announcement day itself not a volume event (IWM below its trailing-60d median in 8 of 8 years) -- with ONE surviving result, IWM-vs-SPY +0.64% on the first tradeable session, 7 of 8 positive, p=0.8%, of which 61% is an overnight gap that cannot be captured without holding small-caps long into an unpublished list. 2026-11-13 is the first out-of-sample observation of any of it, and the proposer registered forward tests against this exact date rather than waiting eight months for June 2027. THE PROPOSER IS EXPLICIT THAT DECEMBER IS A WEAKER TEST THAN IT LOOKS: there is no December announcement history at all, the December convention is four weeks rather than five, and the December turnover is itself unmeasured -- so a December print informs the June mechanic only directionally. Lists post after 6 p.m. ET on a Friday, so the first tradeable session is Monday 2026-11-16. Impact low, status estimate: an announcement moves no shares, the measured window is a null, no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (re-grepped 2026-09-06, zero hits), and shorting is blocked house-wide -- it widens caution and licenses nothing. Kind `sector` matches the sibling market-structure flow entries; the enum has no index-flow member and the imperfect fit is named, not fixed from this lane.
